name: hyperchord
description: Extract chords from audio or MIDI tracks into a labelled chord track; name any selected chord.

scripts.package: npm run build && ableton-extensions-cli package -o HyperChord.ablx -i dist/crema-worker.cjs -i dist/assets -i node_modules/onnxruntime-node/package.json -i node_modules/onnxruntime-node/dist -i node_modules/onnxruntime-node/bin/napi-v6/darwin -i node_modules/onnxruntime-common
